id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2353: "...Sorry. The cold seems to have left me weak-hearted.

id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2380: "Sorry, but I can't think of anything now. Come again when my cold is gone.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|23a2: "Oh, it's you... I've heard from Sancho. You've helped me a great deal this time.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2404: "Oh, it's you... I've heard from Sancho. You've helped me a great deal this time.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|23ac: "When I returned to Santa Rosa, I suddenly felt a chill, caught a cold, and collapsed. As if a demon had possessed me...
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|240e: "When I returned to Santa Rosa, I suddenly felt a chill, caught a cold, and collapsed. As if a demon had possessed me...

id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|241b: "But thanks to you, everyone's colds are completely better. Thank you truly for helping us.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|23c3: "...Actually, the king summoned me and I'm heading to a country called Rhinehart. There's a reason I must hurry.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|23d0: "My only worry is my only son. I can never spend time with him, and I'll make him lonely again this time.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|23dc: "So when the Rhinehart matter is done, I plan to play with him a lot. He's obedient, but still a child.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|23eb: "Traveler, you too, cherish your family. It'll be too late once you're apart.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2425: "...By the way, do you have something to ask me?
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2433: "I see. If there's anything I can tell you, ask anytime.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2444: "...Hm? A young man calling himself the Prince of Cannock came here, you ask?
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|248b: "...Hm? A young man calling himself the Prince of Cannock came here, you ask?
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|244d: "Just now, that very young man came and asked whether I was Midenhall royalty.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2494: "Just now, that very young man came and asked whether I was Midenhall royalty.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2458: "Royalty, true, but when I told him I'm the king of a country called Gran Bania, he seemed deeply downcast.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|249f: "Royalty, true, but when I told him I'm the king of a country called Gran Bania, he seemed deeply downcast.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2466: "The young man looked exhausted, murmured 'I'm going to the Lost Woods now...' and disappeared from before me.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|24ad: "The young man looked exhausted, murmured 'I'm going to the Lost Woods now...' and disappeared from before me.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2475: "Who was that young man... Either way, he was deeply downcast. I hope he doesn't do something rash...
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|24bc: "Who was that young man... Either way, he was deeply downcast. I hope he doesn't do something rash...
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|24e7: "S-sorry. Do you need my master? He's bedridden with a cold right now, so you can't see him. Wheeze...
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|24f2: "I'm also immobilized by a high fever, though I should be tending my master. This is the greatest failure of Sancho's life!
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2502: "My master's cold is so potent it's spread not just to me but to everyone in the village, raging on...
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|25ab: "My master's cold is so potent it's spread not just to me but to everyone in the village, raging on...
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2510: "Cough cough... at this rate everyone will fall and Santa Rosa will be ruined. So I have a request...
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|251b: "Rumor says there's an ultimate cold medicine somewhere that cures even the most stubborn cold.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2525: "I hesitate to ask a traveler, but you're our only hope. Could you find the ultimate cold medicine?
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|253b: "I see... If you're busy, it can't be helped. Sorry for asking too much. Wheeze...
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2554: "Oh, thank you! There are kind people in this world after all. Cough, cough!
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|255f: "However, I'm sorry to say Sancho has no idea where the ultimate cold medicine is.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|256b: "But while delirious with fever, I heard someone's voice...
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|25c5: "But while delirious with fever, I heard someone's voice...
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2574: "World Inn Association... Rica's inn... get medicine at the shop there that can order anything... it said.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|25ce: "World Inn Association... Rica's inn... get medicine at the shop there that can order anything... it said.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2583: "Whether it was a divine oracle or just a dream, I don't know... but that voice is my only clue.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2590: "So, traveler, please find a place called Rica's inn and get the medicine, I'm counting on... ah-choo!
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|25ea: "So, traveler, please find a place called Rica's inn and get the medicine, I'm counting on... ah-choo!
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|25b9: "I wish there were an ultimate cold medicine that cures even the most stubborn colds, but I've no idea where it is.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|25dd: "Whether it was a divine oracle or a dream, I don't know, but that voice is my only clue.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|25fb: "Cough, cough, welcome back... Did you get the ultimate cold medicine? Could you hand it to Sancho...?
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2609: "I-it can't be found so easily. I got ahead of myself in my zeal to save my master... wheeze.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2624: "Oh, this is the ultimate cold medicine...! If I drink it, my master and everyone's colds will surely be cured!
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|262f: "You truly saved us! It's small, but please let me thank my life's savior! Cough, ahem!
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|263d: "Still... that Rica's inn actually existed is surprising. What was the voice I heard in my dream...?
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|264c: "Well, everyone's well again, so that's fine! It's best not to think too hard. My head would hurt again, ha ha ha!
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2662: "Thanks to the ultimate cold medicine, I'm in great shape. Thank you so much!
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|266d: "My master must be overjoyed that he can continue his journey with the young master.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2679: "Come to think of it, I don't see the young master. Where did he go... He disappears the moment I look away.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2691: "Ah-choo! Sniffle... Brr, cold, cold... Even by the bonfire, it's cold.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|269c: "After I drank the ultimate cold medicine, my body got warm and toasty. So cozy, so happy~.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|26ae: "The moment Pankraz came back to this village, everyone caught a cold... What on earth happened... Ah-choo!
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|26bd: "That cold even took down Pankraz, so it was truly terrible. Illness is scary.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|26d1: He's barely breathing,⏎and looks to be in great pain.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|26db: "Pankraz has been traveling for years with Santa Rosa as his base. Apparently he's searching for something precious.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|26e7: "But this cold must have taught him the importance of resting. I hope he takes it easy from now on.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|26fb: "No matter how much I blow my nose, it flows like a waterfall. Please don't look...
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2707: "Ow... I blew my nose so much it's all crusty. Please don't look...
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2726: "Oh, you're a traveler, right? Sorry to ask so suddenly, but please hear me out!
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2731: "My brother went to buy the spirit crown for the festival in the town below, but...
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|273f: "For some reason he came back all stylish and polished. He used to be an ordinary brother...
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|274b: "Everyone's praising his charisma, but that's not my brother! He's definitely a fake!
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|27c6: "Everyone's praising his charisma, but that's not my brother! He's definitely a fake!
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2756: "So I want to expose the fake's true identity somehow!
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|275d: "Please, traveler. Could you look for something that can expose a fake?
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2770: "I see... Being asked this suddenly must be trouble. Sorry.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2782: "Really?! Hee hee, thank you! Your kindness is just like my brother's!
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|278c: "To find a clue you'll need to ask around. If you go to the big inn with Luida's tavern, someone there may know.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|27de: "To find a clue you'll need to ask around. If you go to the big inn with Luida's tavern, someone there may know.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|279d: "If you know of such a place, ask about something that can expose the truth! Thanks, traveler!
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|27ef: "If you know of such a place, ask about something that can expose the truth! Thanks, traveler!
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|27b7: "My brother went festival shopping in the town below and came back all stylish...
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|27d1: "I want to expose the fake! So I'd like you to find something that can expose a fake.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2806: "Oh, welcome back, traveler! So, did you find a clue about something that can expose the truth?
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2810: {var:1} told Tania that⏎they got the Unmasking herb.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2817: "Oh my! If I use that, I can expose the fake brother's true identity!
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2820: "Then use that herb on the fake brother right away! Let's open everyone's eyes!
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2830: "That brother was a fake after all! A monster in disguise, can you believe it...!
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|283a: "Please, traveler! Take down that wicked monster who used my brother's name!
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|284b: "I'm glad the fake brother is gone, but...
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2850: "Where is my real brother dawdling? He should be home by now.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|285b: "Honestly, big brother... Ah, I want to show him my spirit costume for the village festival soon.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2878: "Wh-whoa...! The village youth, who always seemed a bit unreliable, came back with amazing charisma!
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2883: "This is no mere Spirit Festival! It's a Charisma Festival! Let's start the Charisma Festival!
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2892: "W-what!? I thought he came back with charisma, but now he turned into a monster!
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|289d: "I don't understand what young people do these days. Mumble mumble...
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|28a9: "Well, that was surprising. A village youth became charismatic and the charismatic one became a monster.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|28b2: "The Charisma Festival is tempting... but let's enjoy the Spirit Festival as usual.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|28c7: "Her own brother came back so refined, but Tania seems displeased...
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|28d2: "She's probably afraid her brother, tinted by the city, will leave her. Tania is so cute.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|28e1: "Eek... what's that monster!? Where did the charisma from earlier go!?
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|28ee: "I thought a charismatic star was born in Lifecod and would soar to the world.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|28f9: "But it was a fake, and Tania seems happy, so all's well that ends well.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|291d: "Why didn't I notice until now? His charm... hee hee.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2927: "He usually acts so plain but hid this charisma... Women are weak to a gap like that.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2934: "What's that uncool monster?! Where did my Lord Charisma go?!
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2942: "Lord Charisma, my foot. Thinking I was fooled by such a monster, how infuriating!
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|294b: "Men should be chosen for sincerity, not charisma. A man who deceives women is no good.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|295e: "Eek, eek! Lord Charisma, look this way!
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2970: "All that fuss over Lord Charisma ate up so much time.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2976: "Now we need to prepare the festival to welcome the spirit! It'll get busy!
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2986: "I lived in this backwater, but I got baptized by the city at the foot of the mountain and was reborn.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2993: "Look at this overflowing charisma! Blue spiky hair is so old! From now on is the age of this charisma hair!
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|29a9: "I came to Dharma Temple seeking a new life.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|29b1: "For some reason, many old men are crowding the temple head, so no one can change class now.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|29c2: "Dharma Temple has finally resumed its duties.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|29c8: "And now it seems you can become a Bouncy Babe too... Since I'm here, maybe I'll change class.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|29d8: "I came here to become the sage I admire... How long must I wait...
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|29e5: "The old men's uproar has calmed, and I can finally become the sage I admire. Ah, I hope my turn comes soon...
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|29fa: "This Dharma Temple is an indispensable training ground for people to gain power against monsters.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2a07: "But with such an uproar, none will grow to face the monsters... This is going to be serious.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2a16: "She looks like a Bouncy Babe but is an old man inside?! You can't let your guard down!
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2a26: "Because of this uproar, other job-changers have stopped visiting the temple. At this rate, Dharma Temple...
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2a39: "Now Dharma Temple is back to normal. Other job-changers will visit again.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2a46: "It's all thanks to you. Thank you for saving Dharma Temple.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2a57: "Many people have visited Dharma Temple so far... but none became Bouncy Babes.
id./param/region/r024.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2a62: "Is Bouncy Babe even a class...? Well, that's something we don't say.

tm.「すまぬが 今は 何も考えられそうにない……。\n 私のカゼが治った頃に また来: "Sorry, but I can't think of anything now. Come again when my cold is gone.
tm.「おお あなたは……。\n サンチョから 話は聞いている。\n 今回は ずいぶん: "Oh, it's you... I've heard from Sancho. You've helped me a great deal this time.
tm.「サンタローズに帰ってきたら 急に寒気がして\n カゼをひき 倒れてしまったのだ: "When I returned to Santa Rosa, I suddenly felt a chill, caught a cold, and collapsed. As if a demon had possessed me...

tm.「……じつは 国王に呼ばれて\n ラインハットという国に 向かうところでな。\n: "...Actually, the king summoned me and I'm heading to a country called Rhinehart. There's a reason I must hurry.
tm.「ただ 気がかりなのは ひとり息子でな。\n いつも かまってやれず 今回もまた: "My only worry is my only son. I can never spend time with him, and I'll make him lonely again this time.
tm.「だから ラインハットの件を終えたら……\n たくさん遊んであげようと 思ってい: "So when the Rhinehart matter is done, I plan to play with him a lot. He's obedient, but still a child.
tm.「旅の方よ あなたも\n 家族を 大切にしてあげるんだぞ。\n 離ればなれになっ: "Traveler, you too, cherish your family. It'll be too late once you're apart.
tm.「……ところで 私に\n 何か 聞きたいことでもあるのか？: "...By the way, do you have something to ask me?
tm.「そうか。\n 私に わかることがあったら\n いつでも 聞いてくれ。: "I see. If there's anything I can tell you, ask anytime.
tm.「……む？\n サマルトリアの王子と 名乗る若者が\n ここに 来なかったかだと: "...Hm? A young man calling himself the Prince of Cannock came here, you ask?
tm.「先ほど まさに その若者がやってきてな。\n 私のことを ローレシアの王族では: "Just now, that very young man came and asked whether I was Midenhall royalty.
tm.「たしかに 王族には ちがいないが\n 私は グランバニアという国の王だと告げる: "Royalty, true, but when I told him I'm the king of a country called Gran Bania, he seemed deeply downcast.

tm.「あの若者は いったい なんだったのか……。\n どちらにせよ ひどく落ち込んで: "Who was that young man... Either way, he was deeply downcast. I hope he doesn't do something rash...
tm.「す すみません。だんなさまに ご用ですか？\n ただいま カゼで寝込んでおりま: "S-sorry. Do you need my master? He's bedridden with a cold right now, so you can't see him. Wheeze...

tm.「だんなさまが ひいたカゼが とても強力で\n この私だけでなく 村中の人間に: "My master's cold is so potent it's spread not just to me but to everyone in the village, raging on...
tm.「ゴホゴホ……このままでは みんな倒れ\n サンタローズは 滅びてしまいます。\: "Cough cough... at this rate everyone will fall and Santa Rosa will be ruined. So I have a request...
tm.「ウワサによると どこかに\n どんな しつこいカゼでも治すという\n 最強のカ: "Rumor says there's an ultimate cold medicine somewhere that cures even the most stubborn cold.
tm.「旅の方に お願いするのは気が引けますが\n もう あなただけが頼りなのです。\: "I hesitate to ask a traveler, but you're our only hope. Could you find the ultimate cold medicine?
tm.「そうですよね……。\n お忙しいのなら 仕方ありません。\n ムリを言って す: "I see... If you're busy, it can't be helped. Sorry for asking too much. Wheeze...
tm.「おおっ ありがとうございます！\n 世の中には 心優しい お方が\n いらっし: "Oh, thank you! There are kind people in this world after all. Cough, cough!
tm.「しかし 申し訳ありませんが このサンチョ\n 最強のカゼぐすりが どこにあるの: "However, I'm sorry to say Sancho has no idea where the ultimate cold medicine is.
tm.「ただ 熱に うかされている時\n 何者かの声が 聞こえてきましてね……。: "But while delirious with fever, I heard someone's voice...
